title: FOR UPDATE and SKIP LOCKED
description: Select the next available (unlocked) job from a queue using SKIP LOCKED. Mark it as 'in_progress' by updating its status, and return the job details.
hints: SELECT ... FROM jobs WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
UPDATE jobs SET status = 'in_progress' WHERE job_id = ...
SKIP LOCKED skips rows locked by other transactions
